$comment: Gear that costs to use in combat: it wears down (Barrows, Moons, crystal) or burns charges per hit or cast. Matched as name substrings (lower-case) against the gear corpus; 'except' substrings veto a match. Charge-once items (dragonfire shield, ward, ancient wyvern shield) and teleport/skilling charges are deliberately absent. Definition: Andrew, 2026-09-08 - corrupted crystal, emberlight and the plain whip are not charged.
